# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Open a private security advisory (GitHub → Security → Report a vulnerability)
or email the owner. Please do not open public issues for security problems.

## Scope notes

- This is a demo application with synthetic data. No real patient data may be
  stored in or submitted to any part of this system.
- LLM outputs are informational only, carry a disclaimer, and are never
  clinical advice.
